intro: API ek contract hai: request ka shape, response ka shape aur failure ka behaviour. Is section me routing, validation, status codes, pagination aur error handling ko pure functions me banaya jata hai, taaki framework badalne par bhi concepts wahi rahein.
theory: Route method + path ko handler se jodta hai. Path parameters resource identify karte hain, query parameters filtering/pagination karte hain.
Input validation boundary par honi chahiye: missing field, wrong type aur out-of-range values ko 4xx status ke saath clear error do.
Status codes contract hain: 200 success, 201 created, 400 bad request, 401/403 auth, 404 missing, 422 validation, 500 server error.
Pagination me limit/offset ya cursor use hota hai; response me total/next hona chahiye taaki client poora data fetch kar sake.
Errors ko ek shape me return karo ({error: {code, message}}), aur unexpected exception ko 500 me badlo bina internals leak kiye.

explain: Path parameter resource identify karta hai aur type conversion boundary par hota hai.
Output ko print se verify karo.
Ye APIs, Flask/FastAPI & Production Python ka basic building block hai.

examples.code:
from urllib.parse import parse_qs

query = 'city=pune&limit=10'
print(parse_qs(query))
explain: Query string ko parse karke filters aur pagination options milte hain.
Ek step aur jodne se behaviour kaise badalta hai, dekho.
Input badal kar edge case test karo.
Routing, handler, not-found error aur pagination ek hi chhote app contract me.
Ye snippet end-to-end flow dikhata hai.
Output ko project/interview me evidence ki tarah use karo.

realWorld: Frontend aur mobile app API contract par depend karte hain; response shape badalna breaking change hota hai — versioning zaroori hai.
Payment/order endpoints me idempotency key duplicate requests se double charge rokti hai.
Health endpoint, structured errors aur request logging production readiness ke basic checks hain.

interview.q: 400 aur 422 me kya fark hai?
interview.a: 400 malformed request (parse nahi ho sakti), 422 syntactically valid par semantically invalid (validation fail). FastAPI/Pydantic validation errors 422 dete hain.

interview.q: Pagination me offset aur cursor kab use karoge?
interview.a: Offset simple hai par bade/chaning datasets me duplicates ya misses de sakta hai. Cursor stable ordering par next page deta hai aur scale better karta hai.

interview.q: API versioning kaise karte hain?
interview.a: URL prefix (/v1), header ya media type se. Breaking changes naye version me; purana version deprecation window ke saath chalta rehta hai.

interview.q: Idempotency key kya solve karti hai?
interview.a: Client retry karne par same request do baar process na ho — server key store karke pehla response repeat karta hai. Payment jaise side effects ke liye zaroori hai.

debugging.why: Naam ki spelling galat hai; Python namespace me wo naam nahi milta. Ye APIs, Flask/FastAPI & Production Python ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.lesson: NameError typo ya missing assignment batata hai.

debugging.error: Logic error — sort() None return karta hai, list print nahi hoti
debugging.why: sort() in-place hai aur None deta hai, isliye print None dikhata hai. Ye APIs, Flask/FastAPI & Production Python ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: sorted() use karo ya pehle sort phir list print karo.
debugging.lesson: Mutating methods ka return value None hota hai — usse assign/print mat karo.

debugging.broken:
prices = [100, 200]
total = 0
for p in prices:
    total = p
print(total)
debugging.error: Logic error — total 200 aata hai, sum 300 hona chahiye
debugging.why: Assignment purani value replace karta hai; accumulator chahiye. Ye APIs, Flask/FastAPI & Production Python ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: total += p use karo ya sum(prices).
debugging.correct:
prices = [100, 200]
total = 0
for p in prices:
    total += p
print(total)
debugging.lesson: Logic bugs exception nahi dete — chhote sample par expected value likho.

debugging.error: Logic error — pehla do items chahiye the, sirf pehla aaya
debugging.why: Slice ka end exclusive hota hai; 0:1 sirf index 0 deta hai. Ye APIs, Flask/FastAPI & Production Python ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.lesson: Slice boundaries exclusive hoti hain — range jaisa hi rule.
